verdict.rationale: Capacities documents a Full Export, including scheduled automated full exports (Settings > Full Export). Properties become front-matter values and collections are stored as CSV, and the docs describe the output as both human- and machine-readable, so it can be reused in other apps. A REST API (with an OpenAPI spec) also gives programmatic access to content. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the export is complete and lossless, and explicit documentation of how media/files and links are exported (the Markdown body format is only implied by the front-matter mention).
